prompt: Create a detailed graphite pencil and colored pencil portrait of a handsome young Indian man shown from the chest up, centered and facing forward with direct eye contact and a subtle warm smile. He has stylish messy black hair with long textured strands falling over the forehead, expressive brown eyes, thick eyebrows, and a neatly shaped full light beard and mustache. Dress him in a bright orange hoodie with a thick folded hood, soft fabric wrinkles, and two visible off-white drawstrings hanging down the front. Use a realistic hand-drawn mixed-media style: fine graphite linework, charcoal-like cross-hatching, visible pencil strokes, colored pencil shading, and intricate hair and beard texture. Add a large rough circular orange scribble halo behind the head, matching the hoodie, on a warm beige aged paper background with subtle grain and sketchbook texture. Keep the composition vertical, close-up portrait, high detail in the face, loose expressive sketch marks around the shoulders and background, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一幅细腻的石墨铅笔与彩色铅笔肖像，主角为 一位英俊的年轻印度男性，采用胸部以上构图，居中正对镜头，目光直视前方，带着温和的微笑。他留着 时尚且略显凌乱的黑色短发，几缕富有质感的发丝垂在额前，拥有深邃的棕色眼睛、浓密的眉毛，以及修剪整齐的浅色胡须。让他穿着一件 亮橙色 连帽衫，连帽衫带有厚实的折叠帽檐、柔软的布料褶皱，以及两条垂在胸前的米白色抽绳。采用写实的手绘混合媒介风格：精细的石墨线条、类似炭笔的交叉排线、清晰的铅笔笔触、彩色铅笔阴影，以及细腻的头发和胡须质感。在头部后方添加一个巨大的、粗犷的橙色涂鸦光环，与连帽衫颜色呼应，背景为带有细微颗粒感和素描本纹理的暖米色旧纸张。保持竖构图，特写肖像，面部细节丰富，肩部和背景处保留随性且富有表现力的草图笔触，无文字，无水印。
